summary.text: Joe Glynn is a Gulf War Veteran Party candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 1st Barnstable District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran and retired firefighter and EMT, he is listed by Ballotpedia as an officeholder of the Dennis-Yarmouth Regional School District for Yarmouth, with a term ending in 2029.

paragraphs.text: Joe Glynn served in the U.S. Army from 1986 to 1995.

He earned a high school diploma from Newman Preparatory School and an associate degree from Cazenovia College in 1985, and he graduated from the Army Officer Candidate School at the Massachusetts Military Academy in 1995.
His career experience includes working as a firefighter and EMT.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Glynn described himself as a Gulf War veteran who served with the 101st Airborne Division, a retired Boston firefighter and EMT, and the father of three sons.
He listed past or current community roles that include service on the Dennis-Yarmouth school committee as liaison to the Yarmouth Select Board and as vice chairman of the Yarmouth Housing Authority.
He said his campaign centers on opposition to hyper-partisanship, that he is running outside the party system, and that he is passionate about veterans, housing and education.
